description:
Doug visits 11 of the deadliest natural places on Earth, from the scorching floor of Death Valley to the lava lake of Nyiragongo, ranked by how fast each one kills: hours, then minutes, then seconds. Along the way: an island of golden lanceheads, quicksand that can't actually sink you, a lake that doesn't turn animals to stone, and the most lightning on the planet.

Where should we send Doug next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad day.
